title: Wine Sauce for Plum Pudding
steps: Melt the butter, add the sugar and the wine, grate nutmeg over and serve hot with the pudding.
note: a sweet pudding sauce in an old book: sherry or Madeira

title: Calf's Foot Jelly
steps: Boil the feet, strain, add the sugar, lemons and wine, clear with the whites and run through a jelly bag.
note: calf's foot jelly takes sherry or Madeira

title: Syllabub
steps: Whisk the cream with the sugar, lemon and wine until it froths.
note: syllabubs were made with white wine or with sherry; the recipe does not tell

title: Stewed Beef
steps: Brown the beef, add the onions, carrots and wine, cover and stew gently two hours.
note: a meat braise takes table wine

title: Mock Turtle Soup
steps: Add the wine and forcemeat balls just before serving.
note: mock turtle soup is finished with sherry or Madeira

title: Trifle
steps: Soak the cakes and macaroons in the wine, pour the custard over and cover with whipped cream.
note: trifle cakes are soaked in sherry

title: Mulled Wine
steps: Heat the wine with the spices and sugar; do not let it boil.
note: mulled wine is table wine

title: Stewed Carp
steps: Lay the fish in a stewpan with the onions and mushrooms, pour over the wine and stew gently.
note: fish stewed in wine takes table wine

title: Orange Jelly
steps: Dissolve the isinglass, add the juice, sugar and wine and pour into a mould.
note: a sweet jelly in an old book: sherry

title: Negus
steps: Pour the boiling water on the wine, sugar and lemon and grate in nutmeg.
note: negus is made with port or sherry

title: Bishop
steps: Roast the oranges stuck with cloves, add them to the wine with the sugar and heat.
note: bishop is a hot port punch

title: Stewed Kidneys
steps: Fry the kidneys, dredge with flour, add the wine and stew a few minutes.
note: stewed kidneys take sherry, Madeira or claret; the recipe does not tell

title: Ragout of Mutton
steps: Stew the mutton with the vegetables; add the wine at the last.
note: an old ragout may take port or claret

title: Boiled Ham
steps: Boil the ham in the cider, skin it, stick with cloves and glaze with the sugar.
note: ham boiled in cider: sweet in American books, hard in English ones

title: Cider Jelly
steps: Soak the gelatine, dissolve in the hot cider with the sugar and lemon and set in a mould.
note: a cider jelly may be made with either

title: Pork Chops with Apples
steps: Brown the chops, lay the apples over and pour in the cider; bake one hour.
note: the recipe does not say which cider

title: Apple Butter
steps: Boil the cider down to half, add the pared apples and cook all day until thick.
note: apple butter is boiled down from sweet cider

title: To Clean Silk
steps: Sponge the silk with the alcohol and press while damp.
note: alcohol for cleaning cloth is not food

title: Spirit Lamp for the Chafing Dish
steps: Fill the lamp with alcohol and light it under the blazer.
note: lamp fuel is not food

title: Cherry Bounce
steps: Put the cherries and sugar in a jar, pour the alcohol over and let stand three months.
note: cherry bounce is a cordial made on spirits

title: Vanilla Extract
steps: Split the beans and cover with the alcohol; let stand a month, shaking daily.
note: the spirit of a home-made extract is drinkable alcohol

title: Burning Sauce for Christmas Pudding
steps: Pour the alcohol over the pudding and set it alight.
note: flamed over a pudding: a drinkable spirit

title: To Make Cider Vinegar
steps: Put the cider in a cask in a warm place and let it ferment until sour.
note: the recipe ferments its cider, so a sweet reading is refused

title: Cider Cup
steps: Add the yeast and let it work three days before bottling.
note: yeast and working: a sweet reading is refused

title: Spiced Cider
steps: Keep the cider in a barrel until wanted.
note: kept in a barrel: a sweet reading is refused

title: Wine Jelly
steps: Dissolve the gelatine in boiling water, add sugar, orange juice and the wine.
note: an old wine jelly takes sherry

title: Jugged Hare
steps: Put the hare in a jar with the onion stuck with cloves and the wine, cover close and stew three hours.
note: jugged hare took port or claret

title: Cider Sauce for Ham
steps: Melt the butter, stir in the flour and sugar and add the cider slowly.
note: the recipe does not say which cider

title: Wine Whey
steps: Boil the milk, pour in the wine and strain off the curd.
note: wine whey was made with white wine or sherry

title: Lemon Cordial
steps: Steep the rinds in the alcohol a week, then add the syrup.
note: a cordial is a drink
